title: Recurrent neural network based language model
authors: T. Mikolov, M. Karafiát, L. Burget, J. Černocký, S. Khudanpur
inst: Brno Univ. of Technology / Johns Hopkins
before: Neural language models used a fixed window of previous words.
problem: A fixed window cannot carry context from arbitrarily far back.
breakthrough: Use a recurrent net as the language model, so context is unbounded in principle. Roughly halved perplexity against backoff n-grams.
why: It proved neural language models beat the statistical state of the art on a real task, not just in theory.
next: The same author's word2vec, and the seq2seq line.
inherits: The neural language model as a serious competitor rather than a curiosity.
